Bramble is a small design studio in Bristol. We help independent bakeries, coffee roasters and craft breweries look as good as what they make.

Selected work

Label redesign for a family-run cider maker. A new identity for a sourdough bakery with three shops. Seasonal packaging for a coffee roaster.
